competences.description: Attacks the enemy to remove 1 beneficial effect with a 50% chance. Increases your Attack Bar by 30% if all your skills are on cooldown.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: If all your skills are on cooldown.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times to decrease its Defense for 2 turns with a 30% chance each. Increases your Attack Bar by 35% whenever this attack lands as a Critical Hit.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to increase their chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns and decrease their Attack Bar by 30%.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.
